source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of natural and induced mutations (PDF 142-143).

items: Qudrati (spontaneous) mutations replication ke dauran silsile ki ghaltiyon ya DNA ke nuqsan se hoti hain. Yeh evolution ke amal ka hissa hain aur mufeed, bay-asar ya nuqsandeh ho sakti hain.

Induced mutations bairooni awamil se hoti hain: mutagenic maadde ya radiation, mahol ke kimiyai maadde jaise kuch pesticides aur sanati aaloodgi, ya ilaaj jaise chemotherapy. In ke sehat par sangeen asraat ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Mutations: evolution mein hissa daar
blocks.text: Har genetic variation ke aakhri zaraye mutation aur recombination hain. Yeh naye DNA silsile (alleles) aur alleles ke naye milap banate hain jo nayi khasiyatein laate hain, mufeed, nuqsandeh ya bay-asar. Qudrati intikhab (natural selection) in variations par amal karta, mufeed khasiyaton ke alleles ki shareh barhti, aur lambe arse mein is se evolution hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Induced mutation ke aik zariye ki misaal dein.
blocks.explanation: Koi aik: radiation, mutagenic kimiyai maadde, kuch pesticides ya sanati aaloodgi, chemotherapy.

items: Qudrati mutations: replication ki ghalti ya nuqsan; evolution ka hissa.
Induced mutations: radiation, kimiyai maadde, aaloodgi, chemotherapy.
Mutation aur recombination natural selection ke liye variation dete hain.
